content.content: When `deccy undo` or `deccy redo` is invoked with arguments whose first is not `--help`, the deccy CLI shall refuse the invocation, naming the argument.
content.rationale: undo and redo take no argument — each names its target from the marker state alone (undo the most recent applied operation's pre-boundary, redo the next undone operation's post-boundary) — so an argument names a selector neither can honour; refusing it, and naming it, keeps the verbs total over their argument surfaces without re-deciding the selection. `--help` is excepted: it is the one argument every verb's form carries (xlvoxmyl), and it is named only in the leading position — anywhere else it refuses like any other.
